cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time
# whitespace-padded large input (valid, ~4 MiB)
doc = {"version":1,"ixps":[],"rib":[{"path":[41,67,109],"count":2},
                                    {"path":[67,109,41],"count":3},
                                    {"path":[109,41,67],"count":5}],
       "priors":[],"declared":[],"order":[[41,67],[41,109],[67,109]],
       "queries":[{"id":"q","path":[41,67,109],"threshold":[1,2]}]}
data = json.dumps(doc).encode()
padded = b' ' * (4194304 - len(data)) + data
print("padded size:", len(padded))
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=padded,capture_output=True,cwd='/workspace')
t1=time.time()
print("elapsed %.2f rc %d" % (t1-t0, p.returncode), json.loads(p.stdout.decode())['links'][0])
# one byte over the limit
over = padded + b' '
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=over,capture_output=True,cwd='/workspace')
print("over-limit:", json.loads(p.stdout.decode()))
# exactly at limit + valid
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=padded[:4194304],capture_output=True,cwd='/workspace')
print("at limit rc:", p.returncode, "ok" if 'links' in p.stdout.decode() else "bad")
EOF
